\[

\]

### 2. Compute the Squared Differences from the Mean
\[
\begin{align*}
(1 - (-10.2))^2 &= (1 + 10.2)^2 = 11.2^2 = 125.44 \\
(-21 - (-10.2))^2 &= (-21 + 10.2)^2 = (-10.8)^2 = 116.64 \\
(-21 - (-10.2))^2 &= (-21 + 10.2)^2 = (-10.8)^2 = 116.64 \\
(-18 - (-10.2))^2 &= (-18 + 10.2)^2 = (-7.8)^2 = 60.84 \\
(8 - (-10.2))^2 &= (8 + 10.2)^2 = 18.2^2 = 331.24 \\
\end{align*}
\]

### 3. Calculate the Sample Variance (\(s^2\))
\[
s^2 = \frac{\sum (x_i - \bar{x})^2}{n - 1} = \frac{125.44 + 116.64 + 116.64 + 60.84 + 331.24}{5 - 1} = \frac{750.8}{4} = 187.7
\]

### 4. Find the Sample Standard Deviation (\(s\))
\[
s = \sqrt{s^2} = \sqrt{187.7} = \sqrt{\frac{1877}{10}} = \frac{\sqrt{1877}}{\sqrt{10}} = \frac{\sqrt{1877 \times 10}}{10} = \frac{\sqrt{18770}}{10}
\]

\]

\left(8 - \left(-\frac{51}{5}\right)\right)^2 &= \left(\frac{40}{5} + \frac{51}{5}\right)^2 = \left(\frac{91}{5}\right)^2 = \frac{8281}{25} \\
\end{align*}
\]
